method.en: Chinese translations of existing place captions for older records linked from V17 stories and readings. Each item preserves the exact English input and all qualifications; established atlas names are reused where available. These translations add no location facts or dates and do not alter source records or coordinates.
method.zh: 为V17故事与阅读所链接的较早条目翻译既有地点说明。逐条保留英文原文及所有限定语，尽量沿用图集中已有的中文名称。译文不增加地理事实或年代，不修改来源条目或坐标。
